lines.en: I jet forward and coast, jet and coast.

lines.zh: 触腕排在后面，像一串软绳。
lines.en: My tentacles trail behind like a string of soft rope.

lines.zh: 我身上一块一块，像海绵。
lines.en: My body is pitted all over, like a sponge.

lines.zh: 我是暖水里的，冷的地方不去。
lines.en: I'm a warm-water squid. I don't go where it's cold.

lines.zh: 我和两三个同伴一起游。
lines.en: I swim with two or three of my own kind.
I slide along the reef, avoiding the light.

lines.zh: 我的身体很软，能挤进缝里。
lines.en: I'm soft enough to squeeze into gaps.
One jet and I retreat fast.

lines.zh: 水从我的孔里过，很舒服。
lines.en: Water passes through my pores. It feels good.
I float up, then sink back.

lines.zh: 我的触腕在水里划着圈。
lines.en: My tentacles trace circles in the water.

lines.zh: 我换个方向，像翻了一页。
lines.en: I change direction like turning a page.

lines.zh: 礁石上的珊瑚，被我碰了一下。
lines.en: I brush the coral on the reef.
I swim slowly to save strength.
There's warmer water ahead.
I ride the warm current.
I hover with my tentacles hanging down.
The pores on me open and close.
I watch the light above and don't move.

lines.zh: 有个小东西钻进我的孔里。
lines.en: Something small has crawled into one of my pores.
I don't mind, and neither does it.

lines.zh: 我吸饱水，身体涨了一圈。
lines.en: I soak up water and swell a size.

lines.zh: 水里有很多细小的东西。
lines.en: There are many tiny things in the water.
I open slowly, then draw in.
This warm water can feed me.
I hear surf beyond the reef.

lines.zh: 我的触腕缠在一起，又松开。
lines.en: My tentacles tangle, then come loose.

lines.zh: 我吐了一点墨，水变暗了。
lines.en: I let out a little ink and the water darkens.
Darkness settles me.
I count the bright flecks in the water.

lines.zh: 你身上有陆地干燥的味道。
lines.en: You carry the dry smell of land.
I'm below you and you didn't see.
The water you're standing in is my home.
You've never seen pores like mine, have you.
Reach in and I'll jet away.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在两边，看得很开。
lines.en: My eyes are set wide and see a lot.
You back off, and only then do I come forward.

lines.zh: 这里暖，你不会想下去的。
lines.en: It's warm here. You won't want to go deeper.
I tilt my body to look at you.

lines.zh: 我的触手贴在石上，等你。
lines.en: My tentacles cling to the rock as I wait.
I jet ink and hide first.
My pores have been crushed flat.
I ball up and sink slowly.
One tentacle is gone.

lines.zh: 血色散开，我的孔里全是它。
lines.en: Blood spreads and fills every pore of mine.
The pain makes me jet wildly.
After that I can't float.
All my color has drained.
I squeeze into the reef.
I can't stay here.
There are crumbs in the water. Yours.
One reach of a tentacle and I have it.
This thing is soft.
I'll take what you drop.

lines.zh: 海绵在我身体里，喝饱了水。
lines.en: Sponges in my body drink their fill.

lines.zh: 我把触腕卷起来，送到嘴里。
lines.en: I curl a tentacle up to my beak.
This taste isn't in the water.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，我浮上来一点。
lines.en: You crouch and I rise a little.

lines.zh: 我喷了一口水，表示高兴。
lines.en: I spout water to show I'm pleased.
When I'm done I'll hide in the reef again.

lines.zh: 你撞上我，像撞一团软东西。
lines.en: You hit me like hitting something soft.
I jet and retreat an arm's length.

lines.zh: 这一下，我身上的水挤出来了。
lines.en: That squeezed the water out of me.
A cloud of ink appears in the water.
My tentacle wraps around your hand.
I let go and retreat slowly.
You stepped on one of my tentacles.
I ball up and float.
The reef knocks me off balance.
We part and the ripples die away.
My group is all nearby.
We lay our tentacles over one another.

lines.zh: 我们的孔，一开一合对得上。
lines.en: Our pores open and close in time.
The eggs will stick under the reef.
In strings, like little beads.
We guard them and keep the fish off.
The warm water will look after them.
When they hatch, they scatter.
By then this place will be crowded.
Our days are short.

lines.zh: 我用触腕卷住，送进嘴里。
lines.en: I coil a tentacle around it and bring it to my beak.
I eat the small things in the water.
That tasted a little sweet.
I tear it into two halves.
I draw it in with a mouthful of water.

lines.zh: 喙咬上去，它一点都不软。
lines.en: My beak meets it and it gives nothing.
I hold it and nibble slowly.
Not enough for the group.
Afterward I wipe my tentacles.
I sink again to look for more.
Something's stirring in the water.
That thing is heavier than water. It's sinking.
I see it, right by the reef.

lines.zh: 我的触腕已经转向那边。
lines.en: My tentacles have already turned that way.
From here, one jet gets me there.

lines.zh: 我换了层颜色，混进海绵。
lines.en: I change color and blend into the sponges.
I gather myself and get ready.
The taste in the water is thickening.
I take the darkest route.
That's the piece I want.
I follow slowly without jetting.
My tentacles reach ahead, feeling.
It's going into a gap in the reef.

lines.zh: 我从礁石上方，悄悄兜过去。
lines.en: I loop quietly over the reef.
My color has deepened.

lines.zh: 湿海绵的味道，从我身上散出来。
lines.en: The smell of wet sponge comes off me.
The ink in the water hasn't cleared.
Good. It can't see.
I draw my tentacles in and wait.

lines.zh: 我再等一个气泡的工夫。
lines.en: I'll wait one more bubble's time.
A tentacle lashes across it.
I jet ink and it loses its bearings.
That one, I've got it wrapped.
I bite with my beak and tear.
It thrashes and the water churns.
I jet again and pull back.
It bit a length off one of my tentacles.
I drag it toward the reef.
Blood and ink in the water.
I let go and sink.

lines.zh: 我浮在暖水里，慢慢张开。
lines.en: I float in the warm water and open slowly.
The water here is just the right warmth.
My kind is over by the reef.
I still carry bits of egg casing.
I jet once to test myself.
The reef's shadow hides me nicely.
There's enough in the water to feed me.
I unfurl my tentacles slowly.
The light above is soft.
I head for warmer water.

lines.zh: 水在烧，我的孔里全是热气。
lines.en: The water burns and hot air fills my pores.

lines.zh: 我被甩到岸上，软得贴住石头。
lines.en: I'm flung onto land and go limp against the stone.
The water's too shallow for my gills to open.

lines.zh: 炸响把我掀翻，墨洒了一路。
lines.en: The blast flips me and leaves a trail of ink.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿进我的身体，停住了。
lines.en: An arrow goes into me and stays.
A light pins me in the water.

lines.zh: 水里没有碎屑了，我空得发软。
lines.en: No crumbs left in the water; I'm soft with hunger.

lines.zh: 雷落进海，我全身的孔都在跳。
lines.en: Lightning hits the sea and every pore on me jumps.

lines.zh: 没有水，我的触腕抓不住东西。
lines.en: No water, and my tentacles have nothing to hold.
